ledger_excerpt:
From National League of Cities v. Usery, 426 U.S. 833, 851–852 (1976):
"We hold that, insofar as the challenged amendments operate to directly displace the States' freedom to structure integral operations in areas of traditional governmental functions, they are not within the authority granted Congress by Art. I, § 8, cl. 3... [T]his exercise of congressional authority does not comport with the federal system of government embodied in the Constitution."
